commitResults.messageTitle: Rename Duke.java to DestroyerOfWorlds.java
Add echo feature to DestroyerOfWorlds.java
Add listing feature to DestroyerOfWorlds.java
commitResults.messageBody:
Add new classes like ChatHistory to be used in the listing feature, along with HistoryEmptyException and HistoryFullException
for exception handling of ChatHistory objects

previously there was no listing feature in the chatbot, however since listing is a
basic feature in most chatbots, we decided to add it for user convenience

commitResults.messageTitle: Add basic task management to DestroyerOfWorlds.java
commitResults.messageBody:
Add basic Task class
Update ChatHistory class to support Tasks
Rename ChatHistory, HistoryEmptyException, HistoryFullException to TaskList, ListEmptyException,
ListFullException, respectively
Update DestroyerOfWorlds class to preserve encapsulation better

The previous implementation of ChatHistory didnt reflect its use case, so we changed its name, along
with its interfaces to reflect its use case better. Furthermore the DestroyerOfWorlds was doing jobs meant
for other classes such as TaskList, so we changed the implementation of
DestroyerOfWorlds' interface to better reflect the encapsulation of the code

Add DeadlineTask class
Add Event Task class
Renamed exceptions package to exception

Previously, the exceptions package didnt fit standard package
naming conventions, so we renamed it to exception.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add exception handling to DestroyerOfWorlds chatbot
commitResults.messageBody: As there was already exception handling in the previous versions of the chatbot, there was nothing to do.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task deletion feature to DestroyerOfWorlds chatbot
commitResults.messageBody:
Update implementation of TaskList class to extend ArrayList<Task>

Previously it was impossible for users to delete tasks from the list. this is unrealistic because in the long run,
the number of lines to print tasks would become really long. So now users can delete tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add save feature to destroyer of worlds chatbot
commitResults.messageBody:
Currently the chatbot does not have a save feature, meaning that everytime the user restarts,
he needs to manually remind the chatbot of all the tasks that he wrote before.
This is hugely inconvenient so we must add a save feature.

In order to add a Save feature there needs to be some sort of command parser.
Thus add command parsing tools also to the chatbot, then use those tool to construct the save feature.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-level-7' Add the save feature from branch-level-7 into the master branch
Add proper time tracking to chat bot
commitResults.messageBody:
The previous versions of the chatbot didnt use actual time objects from java,
because of this, you could enter invalid and wierd times into the chatbot without it caring.

To fix this use the java date time library and formatter in the deadline and task classes.
Then update the command formats for deadline and event.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-level-8' Add proper java time objects into chatbot
Update the repo classes to enforce better OOP principles
commitResults.messageBody: In the previous version there was terrible encapsulation of members. A lot of the things that should have been handled by separate classes, were being handled by the DestoryerOfWorlds class directly. Thus fix this by creating the respective classes for each functionality such as UI, Storage, and Parsing. Furthermore move task management related methods from the DestroyerOfWorlds class into the TaskList class.

commitResults.messageBody:
Previously users couldnt search for tasks, meaning that if a user had a long list of tasks,
it can be hard for him to check the status of a task. So fix this by updating the
parse command method in Parser class, and add a find tasks method to TaskList
